errors.english: the taste of the pain of perfect peace

errors.english: the rule that if the result is absent, the cause must be absent

The Tibetan verses on the Buddha's funeral rites for Śuddhodana are rendered accurately, with the interleaved Sanskrit set apart in notes.
A careful, literal rendering of the argument against the variegated whole and successive superimposition, with root verses kept as verse.

errors.english: are in every way of a nonexistent nature, because they are not apprehended in any way

fix.find: are in every way of a nonexistent nature, because they are not apprehended in any way
